definitions.E1:
Admission to the Construction Management BTech requires:

- An approved departmental pre-entry assessment completed before applying.
- English Studies 12 with at least 73%, or an accepted equivalent.
- **One** of these entry pathways:
  1. Construction-related diploma or degree with at least a 67% GPA, plus one year of construction-industry experience.
  2. Unrelated diploma or degree and the BCIT Construction Operations Associate Certificate, each with at least a 67% GPA, plus one year of construction-industry experience.
  3. Unrelated diploma or degree with at least a 67% GPA, plus eight years of North American construction-management experience in mid- or senior-level roles.
  4. An approved Red Seal trade, an accepted Math 11 option with at least 60%, the Construction Operations Associate Certificate with at least a 67% GPA, and one year of construction experience beyond apprenticeship hours.

A master’s degree alone does not qualify. Certain credentials earned outside Canada, the US, UK, Australia, or New Zealand require an accepted comprehensive course-by-course credential evaluation with GPA calculation.

Contact BCIT for any remaining application details.
definitions.E4:
No. The capstone is a **program-completion requirement**, not an admission requirement.

Later in the program, you must complete the preparatory Professional Standards course, then choose **one** of the two final-project options. Either option requires department approval.
definitions.E5:
To graduate from Construction Management, you must:

- Complete all required program courses.
- Complete at least **4 credits** from the approved management-elective pool.
- Complete **12 Liberal Studies credits**. Part-time students may replace **LIBS 7013 – Race, Class and Gender: Intersections** with an additional approved 3-credit Liberal Studies elective.
- Complete the Professional Standards requirements, including **CMGT 8700 – Industry Based Project Proposal**.
- After CMGT 8700, choose **one—not both—**final project: **CMGT 8800 – Industry Based Project** or **CMGT 8810 – Industry Based Project**. Your chosen option requires department approval and a minimum grade of 50%.

Program details: https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/
definitions.E3:
Before **CMGT 8700 – Industry Based Project Proposal**, you need:

- Completion of the required program coursework before proceeding to your chosen final-project course.
- At least **two years of related work experience**; qualifying admission experience counts toward this total.
- An industry-based project topic.
- An industry sponsor.

Course details: https://www.bcit.ca/courses/industry-based-project-proposal-cmgt-8700/
